title: Chat card (cards/<name>.json)

title.title: Text
title.description: A lang key or literal text.

label.title: Text
label.description: A lang key or literal text.

value.title: Formula
value.description: Reads `@total`, `@roll` (`expression`, `resolved`, `total`, `natural`, `dice`), the recipe's `@rolls` and `@let`, and the entity's data. It cannot roll dice.

actions.description: Buttons under the card. Each acts on the token the clicker has selected on the map: an apply action steps one of its counters, such as taking damage, and a roll action rolls a recipe for it, such as a saving throw.

label.title: Text
label.description: The button's text; a lang key or literal text.

field.title: Path
field.description: A counter (`x-counter`) of the actor it is applied to, such as `hp.value`.

amount.title: Formula
amount.description: How far to step the counter, worked out when the roll is made and rounded as `round()` does: `-@rolls.damage.total` takes damage away, `@total` heals. It reads what rows read.

when.description: A true/false formula worked out when the roll is made, reading what rows read; the card offers the action only when it is true.
when.title: Formula

anyOf.title: Apply action
anyOf.description: Steps a counter of the actor of the token the clicker has selected, within its bounds, if they may edit that actor.

label.title: Text
label.description: The button's text; a lang key or literal text.

roll.title: Name
roll.description: A recipe in `rolls.json`, without an item, rolled for the actor of the token the clicker has selected, if they may roll for it.

args.description: Values the recipe reads as `@args.<name>`, worked out when this card is rolled, such as `{ "dc": "@derived.spellDc" }`.

when.description: A true/false formula worked out when the roll is made, reading what rows read; the card offers the action only when it is true.
when.title: Formula

anyOf.title: Roll action
anyOf.description: Rolls another recipe for the selected token, such as the saving throw a spell asks for.

description: How a recipe roll shows in chat.
